MPI_Init: launchRanks standalone_owned initializes native MPI; tMPI initialization belongs to the internal launcher, and direct frontend Init must throw when unavailable
MPI_Finalize: launchRanks standalone_owned finalizes native MPI; internal launcher owns tMPI finalization, and direct frontend Finalize must throw when unavailable
MPI_Abort: The same main.cpp has --abort -n 4 mode; check-isolated.sh runs it as a separate process and requires failure
